title: Care Shift Crisis Binder
oneLiner: A 72-hour family command center for adult children suddenly managing parent falls, paperwork, meds, and sibling handoffs.
signalRefs: Reddit r/AgingParents: 72-hour checklist after a parent's fall
Reddit r/AgingParents: nearly 100 pages of memory-care paperwork
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app called "Care Shift Crisis Binder" for adult children who suddenly need to coordinate an aging parent's care after a fall or health scare. The app should feel like a calm 72-hour command center: crisis timeline, safety check, medication list, doctor/pharmacy contacts, facility paperwork tracker, sibling task board, call scripts, and next appointment planner. Required screens/sections: gentle onboarding question, urgent status panel, binder tabs, document checklist, sibling assignments, contact cards, and printable/exportable care packet. Design direction: use the calm-consumer profile with reassuring spacing, readable typography, soft but not beige-heavy colors, high-contrast urgent states, and no decorative clutter.
